summary: Iteration 75 — Kids Hubs + Angel Stars MVP. Full backend (17/17 pytest) and frontend (Hubs, Stars, Parent Portal, Gateway, Legacy slugs) tests pass end-to-end. One spec-level discrepancy in catalog count for shared-age actions found; otherwise the build matches the request.

minor.issue: Returns 6 actions instead of the 5 declared in the spec. Founder catalog in angel_stars.py has two actions with multi-age age_slugs (`told_truth` → explorers+dreamweavers, `anon_kindness` → dreamweavers+explorers). Total catalog is still 15 distinct actions, and little-dreamers correctly returns 5. Either tighten the catalog (remove a shared slug per age) or update the spec assertion to 'at least 5'.

Aggressive global rate limit returns 429 'Too many requests' under modest test load (~5 POST/sec). Production parent-approval flow likely OK, but the limit hits a parent clearing many pending requests quickly. Consider per-user budget rather than per-IP.

issues: Both are still painted on the global dark Matrix Aurin chrome. Brand directive in this iteration was 'cream House backgrounds for kids surfaces' — Kids Hubs (cream peach/sage/mint) are correct, but the gateway /kids-universe and the parent portal still sit on black. Acceptable for parent surfaces; flag the gateway since it is the doorway children also see.

/assets/aurin/*-hero.png 404s in preview env (expected per founder note). The onError hides the broken image but the circular frame is empty / silver — consider a lightweight SVG fallback or initials so first-paint feels finished.

action_items: Decide whether explorers/dreamweavers catalog should be exactly 5 (drop one shared slug per age) or update spec to >=5.
Soften the global 429 rate limit on /api/angel-stars/* — current limit kicks in during normal parent batch-approval.
Optional: cream-themed parent portal hero, or SVG Aurin fallback when /assets/aurin/*-hero.png 404s.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is >2,500 lines — Angel Stars endpoints (lines ~2285-2530) should live in their own router module (e.g. angel_stars_router.py) for testability; mirrors what was already done for angel_stars.py catalog.

AngelStarsDecideInput field is `request_id` but POST /angel-stars/request returns `id`. The frontend (ParentStars.jsx) correctly maps `request_id: req.id`, but renaming the input field to `id` would make the API symmetric and prevent integrator confusion.
KidsStarsView.jsx silently swallows errors on /redeem (`} catch {}`). At minimum log so a redeem failure (e.g. 429) surfaces in console; ideally toast.
Gratitude prompt persists to localStorage only — fine for MVP but should be flagged in PRD so parents know it does not sync across devices.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog count for shared-age actions (told_truth, anon_kindness) means explorers/dreamweavers return 6, not 5. /api/angel-stars/* is rate-limited; space POSTs ~1s apart in tests. Approve uses POST body `{request_id: <id>}` (not `id`). Token Bearer test_token_6489e6cf1440 already has tier 1 redeemed and ~11+ balance on little-dreamers — reset that user_id (user_angel_test_*) if you need a clean state.
rca_of_the_issue: Catalog mismatch RCA: ANGEL_STARS_ACTIONS in /app/backend/angel_stars.py marks two slugs (`told_truth`, `anon_kindness`) with two age_slugs each. The /catalog?age_slug= filter (actions_for_age) returns every action whose age_slugs array contains the slug — by design. Spec said 5 per age. Either remove one age tag per shared action or update spec to >=5. No production impact today; flagged for editorial alignment.
